claim: Matching original 8,171,008-byte retail DLL-001 SkillInfoManager.Awake MethodDef 0x0600114A exact 64-byte IL SHA 6a28505974af6c6b789f2555d1a3b7f47f18e6e054c529bca952e1cdf2f8eedd stores singleton inst, initializes skillInfoList, skillInfoList_Reversal and skillIDList through original constructor MemberRefs, then calls four original 59-byte loader MethodDefs in order: ParseSkillParamList 0x0600114D, ParseSkillInfoList 0x0600114B, ParseSkillUnlockInfo 0x0600114F and ParseSkillParamList_Reversal 0x06001151. Their exact #US string resources are respectively DataBase/SkillParam, DataBase/SkillInfo, DataBase/StorySkillUnlock, DataBase/SkillParam_Reversal. Each wrapper calls original Resources.Load MemberRef 0x0A0006DA, casts to UnityEngine.TextAsset TypeRef 0x010000E4, calls get_text MemberRef 0x0A0006DB, constructs a StringReader through MemberRef 0x0A0006DC, calls its distinct original private parser MethodDef 0x0600114E/0x0600114C/0x06001150/0x06001152 and invokes UnloadAsset MemberRef 0x0A0006DF. Complete bytecode of these five source methods (300 bytes), original field and MemberRef identities and private parser MethodDef rows/hashes are checked against matching original DLL. These are source resource requests and parser call edges only; successful resource loading, source text and parse results are not proven.
